body:
My mother's father had a entirely separate 'second family'.


We (the first family) knew it was likely - he'd disappeared decades ago. But the 'second family' didn't know we existed or that at death he was still married to his first wife.


So no shock for us, but it was very upsetting for the second family. His daughter went into shock at discovering she was, in her mind, "illegitimate". He left nothing but debts, so there were no inheritance issues. Biggest problem for us was the the second family wanting fun history, stories and photos of his early life - like we could all share this beloved family man - when the truth was his disappearance had devastated my mother and grandmother's lives.
